verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say it supports over 20 public or private package formats, explicitly naming Container, npm, PyPI, Maven, Cargo, NuGet, Helm and more. A community user independently confirms the 1.17 package registry let them replace Verdaccio, a private npm registry. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of publish/consume workflows per format, details on authentication and visibility controls for private packages.
